levelledPara.title: Array Overview
levelledPara.para: The ODMRAD antenna array is built from 32 array module positions arranged in a planar grid and numbered 1 through 32. Each array module is an independently replaceable line-replaceable unit that contributes a portion of the array's transmit and receive aperture. The array modules are identical and interchangeable between positions.

levelledPara.title: Built-In Test
levelledPara.para: Each array module runs a built-in test (BIT) routine on a periodic schedule and on demand. BIT checks module power, RF path continuity and the module's internal control logic. A module that fails BIT reports a BIT fault code identifying the failed position.

levelledPara.title: Effect of a Failed Array Module
levelledPara.para: When a single array module fails, the array sector served by that module position loses gain, reducing detection range and track quality in that sector. The remaining array modules continue to operate normally and the radar stays in service in a degraded mode until the failed array module is replaced.
